body.speaker: The Prophet (sallallahu 'alayhi wa-alihi)
body.text_en: I and Sa'at were walking together, and I went a little ahead. For instance, you said about the two fingers that two fingers are like this, and I have moved one step ahead.
La ikraha fi al-din (There is no compulsion in religion).
qad tabayyana al-rushdu min al-ghayy (the right course has become distinct from the wrong).
fa man yakfur bi al-taghuti wa yu'min billahi (So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah).
fa qad istamsaka bi al-'urwati al-wuthqa (has grasped the most trustworthy handhold).
la infisama laha (with no break in it).
Wallahu Sami'un 'Alim (And Allah is Hearing and Knowing).
Allahu waliyyu alladhina amanu yukhrijuhum min al-zulumati ila al-nur (Allah is the protector of those who have believed. He brings them out from darknesses into the light).
wa alladhina kafaru awliya'uhum al-taghutu yukhrijunahum min al-nuri ila al-zulumati (And those who disbelieve - their allies are Taghut. They take them out of the light into darknesses).
ula'ika ashabu al-nari hum fiha khalidun (Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein).

body.speaker: Janab Umar
body.text_en: 'bring, extend your hand, I will give you my...' ...I do it. I give bay'ah (pledge of allegiance).

body.speaker: Sayyidna Isma'il
body.text_en: where there is theft or, you can say, loss, whether on land or at sea, all of it happens because of not paying `zakat` properly.

body.speaker: Ali Wajih
body.text_en: You can cut off my neck, but bara'ah from Ali will not happen. Do whatever you want. Bara'ah from Ali will not happen.

body.speaker: The new ruler (son of the previous king)
body.text_en: When you honor your master so much and are in his obedience, then go, I release you. You will also be in our obedience.
And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah. Then every soul will be paid in full what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ja'far al-Sadiq
body.text_en: Allah says, 'As you are, so shall it be for you.'

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: every nabi (prophet) was given an opponent, meaning a shaytan. Every nabi has a shaytan. You know, who was it for Musa 'alayh al-salam? Fir'awn (Pharaoh). Who was it for Ibrahim? Namrud. In this way, in every era, there has been a shaytan. But the Prophet says that for me, there are two shaytans.

body.speaker: Mawlana Husayn
body.text_en: What are you doing, Ali? My Imamat will be established through you. Meaning, you are the remainder.
Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower
Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise
and no one knows its interpretation except Allah and those well-grounded in knowledge
Guide us to the straight path
He is the One who sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom, although they were before in clear error
When the call is proclaimed for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah, then hasten to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade

body.speaker: Bab al-Abwab
body.text_en: This was your trust, I am the final limit (*hadd*), and after me is the Imam al-Zaman, I am giving it to you.

body.speaker: 'aqle awwal (the first intellect)
body.text_en: Ke na main apne se kisi ko paida kar sakta hun, na koi mujhe paida kar sakta hai. Balke hum sab ka paida karne wala koi dusra hai.
That is because they said, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few numbered days," and they were deluded in their religion by what they used to invent.
So how will it be when We gather them for a Day about which there is no doubt, and every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged?

Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent".

body.speaker: Prophet 'Isa
body.text_en: The condition of the world is also like this. What is the point of building a house here?

When Allah said, "O Isa, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection."
They did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear so to them.
None touch it except the purified.
It is He who sent among the unlettered a Messenger

body.speaker: The Prophet
body.text_en: O Ali, you are my wasi here and in the hereafter.

body.speaker: Sayyidna Ja'far al-Sadiq
body.text_en: there is a large circle, that is Islam. Within it is a smaller circle. The one in the smaller circle can claim to be in the larger circle too. But the one in the larger circle... a smaller circle is inside a larger circle. The one in the large circle cannot say he is in the smaller circle.

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Salim)
body.text_en: O Isa, I will relieve you of your duties and include you in my circle and my assembly of da'is. And I will save you from the foul language and evil deeds of the disbelievers, the deniers. And until your era is complete, I will give all believers superiority and elevation over the deniers of the wasi.

body.speaker: The Imam (Maulana Salim)
body.text_en: O Isa, your duty is over. I am relieving you. A great new Prophet is about to come.

body.speaker: Hazrat Asif Fyzee
body.text_en: Until I get the command from my elder, at that time it was Sayyidna Taher Saifuddin, until then, we will not give it.

body.speaker: Hazrat Asif Fyzee
body.text_en: I did not get it from the Majlis-e-Sulaymani Jawwad. And I... from Surat, from Burhanpur, from there I acquired it and printed this.

It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, 'Be servants to me rather than Allah.' Rather, [he would say], 'Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied.'
And he would not order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had submitted?

And [recall] when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him."
He said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."
And whoever turns away after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
You will not attain righteousness until you spend from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.
All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."
Then whoever invents falsehood about Allah after that - it is those who are the wrongdoers.

body.speaker: Imam Ali
body.text_en: These questions are ordinary, what answer should I give? My children will give it.
